name: infantry_list_sessions
description: List the SESSIONS (running or past agent runs, not saved profiles) the Infantry AI daemon knows: id, agentId, role, provider, model, projectId, status.

limit.description: At most this many sessions (live ones first, then the most recent). Default: setting limits.tools.listLimit.

projectId.description: Only this project's sessions. Omitted: a session caller's own project (everyone else: all). "all" lists every project (pm / owner callers only).

name: infantry_get_session
description: One session's status and the last lines of its transcript (from the daemon's replay buffer, bounded).

sessionId.description: Session id, or a unique prefix of one.

lines.description: How many trailing transcript lines to return (default: setting limits.tools.sessionTailLines, 5).

brief.description: Omit the transcript: return only state, live state, last action and last output/event times.

name: infantry_spawn
description: Spawn an Infantry AI session for a role and/or an agent profile, optionally sending it a first task, OUTSIDE the board: it runs in the project folder and leaves every ticket untouched. Never use it for ticket work: start ticket work with infantry_ticket_start (or pass ticketId here, which does the same).

role.description: Role to spawn (role-first, like the `new` frame).

agentId.description: Agent profile id; with role, it must be that profile's role.

projectId.description: Project the session belongs to (default: the caller's project).

provider.description: Harness (provider id) the session runs: see infantry_list_harnesses. Omitted = the daemon's default.

model.description: Model id of that harness (infantry_list_harnesses lists them).

effort.description: Reasoning effort for the session: low, medium, high, xhigh or max (off = the harness default).

task.description: Optional first prompt for the new session.

ticketId.description: Start this board ticket instead (full id or its 8-char suffix), exactly as infantry_ticket_start.

name: infantry_prompt
description: Send a prompt to an existing session (id or unique prefix). Slash commands are refused.

sessionId.description: Session id, or a unique prefix of one.

prompt.description: The words to send to the agent.

name: infantry_kill
description: Kill a session (id or unique prefix). A pm (or the owner) may kill any session in its own project; other roles only sessions they spawned.

sessionId.description: Session id, or a unique prefix of one.

force.description: Kill the process tree at once instead of after the grace period.

name: infantry_list_harnesses
description: List the harnesses a ticket can run on: each harness id (the value of a ticket's provider) with its models (the values of its model), which one is the default, and whether its CLI is available. Pin them with infantry_ticket_create / infantry_ticket_update, then start the ticket with infantry_ticket_start.

name: infantry_usage
description: Read plan usage per meter: percent of the plan window used (the highest window), when it resets, points ahead/under an even burn, and how many ticket workers the pacing rule allows versus how many run. Text summary; pass json=true to append the full JSON report.

json.description: Append the full JSON report after the text summary (default false).

name: infantry_usage_override
description: Override the usage pacing allowance for a meter (owner and pm roles; setting usage.overrideRoles). value = a ticket-worker count, 'none' (no limit) or 'clear' (the pacing rule decides again). The override lasts hours hours, default until the meter resets (else 2h).

meter.description: The meter to override (claude, codex, opencode-go, ...)

hours.description: How long the override lasts, in hours (default: until the meter resets)

name: infantry_pace
description: Read the pacing history the daemon recorded from the plan meters: per provider window the percent used, the pace delta, the projected landing at reset, the momentum and the forecast to reset.

sinceHours.description: Only points from the last N hours (default: all)

samples.description: "true" adds the newest raw samples per series; default off

name: infantry_message
description: Send a message (COMMS mail) to another agent by session id, agent id or role, or to the owner. Replies go in the same thread with replyTo. Returns the message id.

to.description: Recipient: session id, agent profile id, role id, or owner.

replyTo.description: Message id (or 8-char prefix) this answers; keeps the thread.

allowCrossProject.description: Allow a recipient in another project.

name: infantry_inbox
description: List the messages addressed to you (id, from, subject, state). unreadOnly limits it to the ones you have not read.

limit.description: At most this many, newest first.

name: infantry_read
description: Read one message in full by id (8-char prefix works) and mark it read.

name: infantry_session_remove
description: Remove a session from the list. A live session is refused unless force=true, which ends it first. Only the pm or the owner (own project), or the session's spawner, may remove one.

force.description: End a live session and remove it in one step.
